basis: Chloroplast beta-carbonic anhydrase; Lee 2025 S1 mesophyll marker, enriched in seedling mesophyll clusters (6d c3 0.76/0.46; merged c12 0.93/0.30) and in Nobori 2025 Nature leaf mesophyll; broad in green cells, so use with other photosynthetic genes. Raised low->medium for two-study agreement.
Plastid ribosomal protein; cotyledon mesophyll by MERFISH (Lee et al. 2025 Nat Plants Fig 2a,b). Weak in the snRNA DE (merged c12 0.31/0.04).

NDH complex subunit; cotyledon mesophyll by MERFISH (Lee et al. 2025 Fig 2a, ED Fig 3e), but Lee 2025 Table S3 lists it as a stem cortex (chlorenchyma) marker and it is weak in snRNA DE (merged c12 0.22/0.05). NDH is bundle-sheath-enriched in C4 grasses.
HD-ZIP IV L1/epidermis identity factor; enriched in seedling shoot epidermis (6d c0 0.27/0.11) and reporter-validated in Zhang 2021 Dev Cell; shoot epidermis only (not root epidermis).

FIDDLEHEAD/KCS10 cuticle VLCFA synthase of the shoot epidermis (Yephremov et al. 1999 Plant Cell); enriched in Lee 2025 seedling epidermis/trichome clusters (6d c0 0.48/0.20; 6d c16 0.69/0.24) and epidermis-specific in Nobori 2025 and Zhang 2021.

PROTODERMAL FACTOR1, L1-specific by in situ (Abe et al. 1999); enriched in Lee 2025 seedling epidermis/trichome (6d c16 0.30/0.04) and reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025 New Phytol; also cluster-specific in Xu 2025/Zhang 2021. Two+ studies, medium->high.
ABCG12 cuticular wax exporter of epidermal cells (Pighin et al. 2004 Science); Lee 2025 S1 epidermis marker, enriched in 6d c16 (0.34/0.10) and 6d c0 (0.18/0.09). Single study here.

Uncharacterized SAM-domain protein; cotyledon epidermis by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ED Fig 3b, Table S3; also flower epidermis); in seedling snRNA it is specific to the trichome/epidermis cluster (6d c16 0.29/0.02; 12d c12 0.19/0.01).
Alpha-expansin; hypocotyl epidermis per Lee 2025 Table S3 (3d c8 0.66/0.18, the hypocotyl-epidermis cluster). Expansins are growth-zone genes: mark hypocotyl epidermis only, not cotyledon.
Endo-1,4-beta-glucanase; apical hook epidermis by MERFISH in etiolated 3-d seedlings (Lee 2025 ED Fig 3b), not DE in the light-grown snRNA. Conflict: Lee 2025 S1 also lists it as root metaphloem.

bHLH that drives GMC-to-guard-cell transition (Ohashi-Ito & Bergmann 2006 Plant Cell); 6d c19 0.79/0.01 and 12d c11 0.43/0.01 in Lee 2025; guard cluster marker in Zhang 2021. Also expressed in myrosin idioblasts (pFAMA:GUS, Lyu 2025 Nat Plants).

Myrosinase abundant in guard cells (Barth & Jander 2006 Plant J; reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025); 6d c19 0.97/0.09 in Lee 2025. Also in myrosin idioblasts, which co-cluster with guard cells; two studies but shared with another type, so medium.

Glycine-rich protein (uncharacterized); guard-cell reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025 New Phytol and de novo seedling guard-cell marker in Lee 2025 Table S3 (not in the seedling DE sheets). Two independent studies, medium->high.

Myrosinase of phloem-associated myrosin cells; reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025 New Phytol and Lyu 2025 Nat Plants. In Lee 2025 seedling it sits in the guard cluster (6d c19 0.65/0.01; 12d c11 0.57/0.03), so myrosin cells co-cluster with guard cells here.
R2R3-MYB required for trichome initiation (Oppenheimer et al. 1991 Cell); specific to the seedling trichome cluster (6d c16 0.12/0.001). Trichomes occur on true leaves, not cotyledons.
HD-ZIP IV for trichome morphogenesis (Rerie et al. 1994); 6d c16 0.75/0.02, 12d c12 0.69/0.03 in Lee 2025. Also the atrichoblast marker in root: separate shoot and root clusters first.

R2R3-MYB for trichome initiation and branching (Kirik et al. 2005 Plant J); 6d c16 0.34/0.002 in Lee 2025. Also expressed in root non-hair cells (Kang et al. 2009 Plant Cell); 12d c8 (Unknown) carries it with GL2.
NOECK/MYB106 regulates trichome branching and cuticle, expressed in trichomes (Jakoby et al. 2008 Plant Physiol); 12d c12 0.45/0.004, 6d c16 0.37/0.005 in Lee 2025.
WRKY44/TTG2 required for trichome development (Johnson et al. 2002 Plant Cell); 6d c16 0.21/0.003 in Lee 2025. arabidopsis_root.tsv uses it for Atrichoblast: it marks both.
COBRA-like protein required for root hair growth (Brady et al. 2007); cluster-specific in Lee 2025 (12d c3 0.31/0.02) and Shahan 2022 curated marker.
Root-hair-specific alpha-expansin (Cho & Cosgrove 2002 Plant Cell); 12d c3 0.69/0.04 and 6d c15 0.49/0.02 in Lee 2025. Also high in the 12d c15 "Xylem" cluster, which is root hair.
bHLH for root hair elongation (Karas et al. 2009); 12d c3 0.65/0.03 in Lee 2025; trichoblast by PHYTOMap (Nobori 2023 Nat Plants) and Shahan 2022 curated.
bHLH that sets root hair length, expressed in hair cells (Yi et al. 2010 Nat Genet); 12d c3 0.30/0.01 in Lee 2025. UniProt names the protein RSL3 but the gene name is RSL4.
bHLH for root hair growth (Yi et al. 2010); 6d c10 0.50/0.02 in Lee 2025.
bHLH for root hair initiation in the meristem/elongation zone (Menand et al. 2007 Science); weak (12d c3 0.10/0.005) because it is early-stage; Shahan 2022 curated.

Proline-rich cell wall protein with root-hair-specific promoter (Bernhardt & Tierney 2000 Plant Physiol); late hair marker, 12d c3 0.91/0.05, 6d c15 0.76/0.02 in Lee 2025. Reporter plus cluster agreement, medium->high.
Endoglucanase; trichoblast in Shahan 2022 curated list (arabidopsis_root.tsv, medium) and cluster-specific in Lee 2025 (12d c3 0.64/0.04; 6d c15 0.54/0.02). Two studies, medium->high.
Class III peroxidase; enriched in root-hair clusters at all stages (12d c3 0.81/0.04; 6d c15 0.74/0.02) in Lee 2025. Single-cell enrichment only.

HD-ZIP IV that specifies non-hair cells (Masucci et al. 1996); atrichoblast in Shahan 2022 and PHYTOMap (Nobori 2023). Not resolved in Lee 2025 seedling (only candidate: 12d c8, GL2 0.32/0.04 with MYB23, unverified). Also a trichome marker in shoot.
Casparian strip membrane domain protein (Roppolo et al. 2011 Nature); 6d c17 0.40/0.01 and 3d c14 in Lee 2025.
Casparian strip protein (Roppolo et al. 2011); 3d c14 0.50/0.02 and 6d c17 0.17/0.002 in Lee 2025; Shahan 2022 curated.
Casparian strip protein (Roppolo et al. 2011); 6d c17 0.31/0.003 and 3d c14 0.55/0.13 in Lee 2025.
Casparian strip protein (Roppolo et al. 2011); endodermis by seedling MERFISH (Lee 2025 Table S3, "endodermis and vascular"); DE only in 3d c14 (0.60/0.30).
MYB that drives Casparian strip genes (Kamiya et al. 2015 PNAS); 6d c17 0.10/0.005 in Lee 2025; reporter in Shahan 2022 and PHYTOMap in Nobori 2023.
Peroxidase that lignifies the Casparian strip (Lee et al. 2013 Cell); 6d c17 0.31/0.004 in Lee 2025; in arabidopsis_root.tsv.
Uclacyanin in the Casparian strip lignin domain (Reyt et al. 2020 Curr Biol); 6d c17 0.29/0.004 and 3d c14 0.58/0.19 in Lee 2025; Table S3 says endodermis and vascular.
CYP86A1 suberin omega-hydroxylase of root endodermis (Hofer et al. 2008 J Exp Bot); marks suberized (mature) endodermis, 12d c13 0.28/0.003 in Lee 2025 (labeled Unknown). Also periderm/seed coat.

Phosphate exporter that loads the xylem from root pericycle/xylem parenchyma (Hamburger et al. 2002 Plant Cell); top gene of Lee 2025 "phloem parenchyma" 6d c7 (0.49/0.08). Not pericycle-unique (xylem parenchyma, shoot vasculature: Zhang 2021 c6).
NRT1.5 nitrate xylem loader in root pericycle cells next to protoxylem (Lin et al. 2008 Plant Cell); 6d c7 0.69/0.16 and 3d c9 in Lee 2025.
Secondary-wall CESA7 (Taylor et al. 1999); 6d c11 0.21/0.006 in Lee 2025; xylem by seedling and stem MERFISH (Table S3).
Secondary-wall CESA8/IRX1 (Taylor et al. 2000); 6d c11 0.33/0.009 in Lee 2025; Shahan 2022 curated (Wendrich 2020).
Secondary-wall CESA4/IRX5 (Taylor et al. 2003); 6d c11 0.47/0.06 and 3d c12 in Lee 2025. Also fibers.
Tracheary-element cysteine protease (Funk et al. 2002); 6d c11 0.13/0.006 in Lee 2025.
Tracheary-element cysteine protease (Funk et al. 2002); 6d c11 0.31/0.01 in Lee 2025; xylem by stem MERFISH (ED Fig 4l).
Secondary-wall master MYB (Zhong et al. 2007); 6d c11 0.11/0.001 in Lee 2025; Shahan 2022 curated.
Thermospermine synthase of differentiating xylem (Muniz et al. 2008 Development); 6d c11 0.17/0.02 in Lee 2025; reporter in Lyu 2025.
HD-ZIP III of procambium/xylem precursors (Baima et al. 2001); in Lee 2025 it sits in the xylem cluster (6d c11 0.29/0.06), so it marks procambium plus early xylem; cluster marker in Kim 2021.
Companion-cell sucrose/H+ symporter (Truernit & Sauer 1995); 6d c6 0.27/0.03 in Lee 2025 with seedling MERFISH (ED Fig 3c); companion-cell cluster in Xu 2025 and Nobori 2025.
Companion-cell metal-binding protein needed for phloem function (Tian et al. 2010 Plant Cell; Zhu 2016); 6d c6 0.44/0.04 in Lee 2025 and companion-cell cluster in Zhang 2021/Xu 2025.
Plasma membrane H+-ATPase with companion-cell promoter-GUS (DeWitt & Sussman 1995 Plant Cell); 6d c6 0.44/0.06 in Lee 2025; companion-cell cluster in Kim 2021 and Tenorio Berrio 2025. Medium->high.
Phloem lectin of companion cells (Dinant et al. 2003); 6d c6 0.24/0.03 in Lee 2025; reporter in Tenorio Berrio 2025; companion-cell cluster in Kim 2021, Nobori 2025, Xu 2025. Medium->high.
Kinesin NACK1 needed for cytokinesis (Strompen et al. 2002); G2/M state by MERFISH (Lee 2025 Fig 2c,d); 6d c4 0.15/0.01; G2/M marker in Tenorio Berrio 2025.
APC/C activator at mitosis (Kevei et al. 2011); 6d c4 0.24/0.02 in Lee 2025, MERFISH (ED Fig 3d).
Cellulose synthase-like D5 at the cell plate, cell-cycle regulated (Gu et al. 2016 Cell Res); 6d c4 0.27/0.02 in Lee 2025, MERFISH (Fig 2c).
DNA topoisomerase II, proliferation gene; 6d c4 0.35/0.04 and 3d c10 in Lee 2025.
Replication-dependent histone H3.1 (HTR1); defines the 3d c16 / merged c15 "Dividing"/"Vascular" cluster (3d c16 0.90/0.20) in Lee 2025, which is an S-phase/ribosome-rich state, not a type.
Auxin-responsive Aux/IAA; concave-side basal hook cortex by MERFISH in etiolated seedlings, lost in hls1 (Lee 2025 Fig 6g,h). Etiolated hook only; not DE in light-grown snRNA.
Auxin-inducible IAA-amido synthetase; concave apical hook cortex by MERFISH (Lee 2025 ED Fig 9c). Etiolated hook only; auxin-responsive, so state not type.
